{{Top|leg}}
The '''Information Matrix Center''', also known as '''IMAC''', was developed by [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Arms]] to help control the actions of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It was part of the central processing unit, allowing the droid to receive communications from a command center. The IMAC also sent info about the droid's status to this center, where decisions were made on what to do next.
